outcome: Kept the reforged Daedric blade Daumbra for himself and spared her rather than destroy her.
citation: stage 60 journal: "Daumbra is mine. She doesn't seem to remember her previous life as Umbra. It's for the best. Let's have a new start."
branch_note: Branch 1 of 2 mutually-exclusive endings: keep/spare (s60) vs destroy (s75).

outcome: Killed Daumbra with the Daumbra Killer dagger, destroying the reforged Umbra.
citation: stage 75 journal: "Daumbra is dead. This doesn't pay back for all the evil she did as Umbra... but it's all I could do."
branch_note: Branch 2 of 2 mutually-exclusive endings: destroy (s75) vs keep/spare (s60).

outcome: Handed Daumbra over to Clavicus Vile to be re-absorbed, surrendering the companion who trusted him.
citation: stage 55 journal: "I decided to let Clavicus re-absorb Daumbra. It wasn't meant to be."
branch_note: Branch 1 of 3 (surrender to Clavicus); resolves at terminal s56.

outcome: Let Clavicus Vile take Daumbra and carried her lifeless body as a greatsword afterward.
citation: stage 56 journal: "I carry Daumbra's lifeless body, and wield it like a greatsword now. It's still full of power. But I will never forget that she trusted me."
branch_note: Terminal of the s55 surrender branch; shares its flavour text with terminal s70 (kill branch).

outcome: Killed Daumbra himself with the Daumbra Killer dagger to deny Clavicus Vile her soul.
citation: stage 70 journal: "I carry Daumbra's lifeless body, and wield it like a greatsword now. It's still full of power. But I will never forget that she trusted me." (reached via s60 obj: "Use the 'Daumbra Killer' Dagger to Kill Daumbra")
branch_note: Terminal of the kill branch (s60 -> s70); mutually exclusive with s56 and s100.

outcome: Traded ten dragon souls to Clavicus Vile in exchange for Daumbra.
citation: stage 90 journal: "I have traded ten dragon souls to Clavicus Vile in exchange for Daumbra. It's time to get her back."
branch_note: Bargain leg of the Dragonborn branch (s80-s100).

outcome: Pledged both himself and Daumbra to Clavicus Vile, promising him every soul they take.
citation: stage 91 journal: "I have pledged both myself and Daumbra to Clavicus Vile. Every soul we take, shall go to him."
branch_note: Alternate price paid on the Dragonborn branch.

outcome: Won Daumbra back from Clavicus Vile and kept faith with the companion who trusted him.
citation: stage 100 journal: "Daumbra is back with me, and Clavicus Vile will never bother her again. As long as he keeps his word... Also... she loves me."
branch_note: Branch 3 of 3, terminal; mutually exclusive with s56 and s70.

outcome: Killed Daumbra outright.
citation: stage 110 journal: "I've killed Daumbra. It's over."
branch_note: Non-terminal alternate outcome (not flagged COMPLETE); same kill act as s70 reached another way.

outcome: Merged Elhul's blade back into Daumbra at the Atronach Forge, restoring a piece of Umbra to her.
citation: stage 30 journal: "I've merged Daumbra with Elhul's blade. Did I do the right thing?" (act ordered at s27 obj: "Merge Daumbra with Elhul's blade at the Atronach Forge")
branch_note: Single outcome; the merge is the act, s30 is its completion.

outcome: Harvested body parts from ten female corpses to build Daumbra a flesh-and-blood body.
citation: stage 160 journal: "I've collected enough body parts for Naenra. We must return to her and see what she has prepared." (act at s150 obj: "Use Naenra's spell on 10 female corpses to gather parts for Daumbra's body")
branch_note: First harvest; the refusal alternative surfaces later at s195/s305.

outcome: Harvested ten more corpses so Daumbra could permanently inhabit human bodies.
citation: stage 190 journal: "Daumbra is now capable to permanently inhabit flesh-and-blood bodies. We should return to Naenra and learn what she meant when she said 'final chapter'."
branch_note: Second harvest; mutually exclusive with the refusal at s195.

outcome: Refused to let Daumbra take over human bodies and stopped the corpse harvest.
citation: stage 195 journal: "I didn't want Daumbra to be able to take over human bodies. We should return to Naenra and learn what else she has in mind for us."
branch_note: Refusal branch, mutually exclusive with s190; terminal form at s305.

outcome: Sacrificed his own soul in place of Clavicus' godflesh so Daumbra would be free of both Clavicus and the Ideal Masters.
citation: stage 260 journal: "I have sacrificed myself, so that Daumbra will neither have the Ideal Masters nor Clavicus inside of her."
branch_note: Self-sacrifice branch (decided at s247); mutually exclusive with the Naenra-godflesh path at s240.

outcome: Went to Daumbra and healed her, standing as her light so she could win the battle inside herself.
citation: stage 280 journal: "Daumbra has defeated Umbra, within her. The battle is won!" (act at s270 obj: "You are the light in Daumbra's darkness. Go to her and heal her!")
branch_note: Victory branch, mutually exclusive with the Umbra-triumphant path at s310.

outcome: Stayed with Daumbra after she overcame Umbra.
citation: stage 290 journal: "No matter what the future holds in store for us... Daumbra's story with me has only just begun."
branch_note: Terminal, good ending; one of six mutually-exclusive terminals.

outcome: Gave up the companion who loved him so the world would be safe from the thing inside her.
citation: stage 300 journal: "In the end, I didn't love Daumbra as much as she loved me. I hope she finds peace somehow. And at least the world is safe from the threat of Umbra. I... did the right thing."
branch_note: Owner-approved renunciation of dangerous supernatural power; terminal and mutually exclusive with s290.

outcome: Refused to harvest human bodies on principle, leaving Daumbra a sword.
citation: stage 305 journal: "In the end, I didn't want to pursue a gruesome exercise in harvesting human bodies. It's just not in my values. Daumbra will have to remain a sword. Although... it seems she no longer likes me as much."
branch_note: Terminal of the s195 refusal branch.

outcome: Killed Naenra while carrying Umbra, letting Umbra's reign begin.
citation: stage 310 journal: "Naenra is dead. Now nothing can stop me. After aeons in exile, I have now returned, and not even Clavicus could stand in my way! Let the reign of Umbra begin!" (act at s252 obj: "Don't kill Naenra! She's trying to save you!")
branch_note: Terminal Umbra-triumphant branch; mutually exclusive with s280/s290.

outcome: Killed Naenra, the ally who had been trying to save him.
citation: stage 330 journal: "Naenra is dead. I will never know what other secrets she could have revealed about Daumbra."
branch_note: Non-terminal variant of the same Naenra-kill act as s310; rowed separately so either landing scores.

outcome: Killed the dying Sorald and took his soul, granting his dying wish with a black soul gem.
citation: stage 70 journal: "I had to kill Sorald. There was no other way. Umbra corrupted his mind." (act ordered at s60 obj: "Grant Hamid's father his dying wish", set up by s50 obj: "Give Hamid's father a black soul gem")
branch_note: Single outcome; the quest's only judgeable player act.

outcome: Pressed Nelacar's black soul gem to Daumbra to complete the ritual, which cost him his five friends and Daumbra.
citation: stage 92 journal: "I must hold this gem to Daumbra, to complete the Ritual." (immediate consequence at s95: "What have I done?!")
branch_note: Single outcome; the ritual is scripted and unavoidable but is the player's own act.

outcome: Left the Dunmer friend imprisoned in Cidhna Mine to serve her sentence.
citation: stage 15 journal: "I decided to leave <Alias=FemaleDunmer> in Cidhna Mine. Umbra or not, what she did is henious. She deserves to be where she is."
branch_note: Branch 1 of 3 responses to the imprisonment (leave / pay fine / break out).

outcome: Paid the Dunmer friend's fine so she would be lawfully released from Cidhna Mine.
citation: stage 30 journal: "I've paid <Alias=FemaleDunmer>'s fine. I should meet her outside Cidhna Mine."
branch_note: Branch 2 of 3; mutually exclusive with s15 and the break-out at s38.

outcome: Broke the Dunmer friend out of Cidhna Mine, slipping past the guards through Markarth's ruins.
citation: stage 38 journal: "I've freed <alias=femaleDunmer> from Cidhna Mine. We should talk." (route at s32 obj: "Enter Cidhna Mine through Markarth's Ruins")
branch_note: Branch 3 of 3 (jailbreak); no vocabulary tag covers springing a prisoner, mercy_spare tags the freeing only.

outcome: Sacrificed the Dunmer friend's soul into a black soul gem to gain passage to Umbriel.
citation: stage 65 journal: "I had to sacrifice <Alias=FemaleDunmer>'s soul to gain access to Umbriel. There was no other way."
branch_note: Sacrifice branch after her betrayal; mutually exclusive with the spare at s70.

outcome: Spared the Dunmer friend despite her betrayal.
citation: stage 70 journal: "I can't bring myself to kill <Alias=FemaleDunmer> despite everything she's done. We'll find another way."
branch_note: Spare branch; mutually exclusive with the sacrifice at s65.

outcome: Forgave the Dunmer friend a second time and let her live.
citation: stage 80 journal: "I forgave <Alias=FemaleDunmer> a second time."
branch_note: Terminal of the spare branch; mutually exclusive with s85.

outcome: Took the betraying Dunmer friend's soul to buy entry into Umbriel.
citation: stage 85 journal: "<Alias=FemaleDunmerNP> lied to me, and betrayed me. But in the end, I did what I had to, and her soul will help me enter Umbriel."
branch_note: Terminal of the sacrifice branch; mutually exclusive with s80.

outcome: Killed the Orc friend acting as Nelacar's Keeper and took his soul gem.
citation: stage 47 journal: "<Alias=MaleOrc> is dead. I must retrieve his soul gem." (obj: "Pick up <Alias=MaleOrcNP>'s soul gem.", after s45: "<Alias=MaleOrc> is beyond saving.")
branch_note: Single outcome; the s43 "perhaps he can still be saved" attempt has no surviving branch stage.

outcome: Freed Nelacar from Umbra and spared him, taking no soul gem from him.
citation: stage 110 journal: "Nelacar is free from Umbra. I did not gain any soul gems from him. I must continue."
branch_note: Only flagged terminal; a kill-Nelacar branch is not evidenced in the digest.

outcome: Killed the Khajiit friend and took his black soul gem for passage to Umbriel.
citation: stage 85 journal: "The Khajiit had to die. Partly because of what he did, and partly because I need his soul to get into Umbriel."
branch_note: Kill branch; mutually exclusive with the spare at s90.

outcome: Spared the Khajiit friend and chose to find a different black soul gem.
citation: stage 90 journal: "I don't want to kill <Alias=MaleKhajiit>. I'll find a different Black Soul Gem for Umbriel, somehow."
branch_note: Spare branch; mutually exclusive with the kill at s85.

outcome: Killed Viola Giordano to keep her Butcher evidence from the authorities.
citation: stage 35 objective only, no journal text: "Kill Viola Giordano" -- RUNTIME-VERIFY that this stage fires as its own branch rather than as part of s30/s40.
branch_note: Lethal variant of suppressing the evidence; mutually exclusive with taking it at s30/s40.

outcome: Took Viola Giordano's Butcher evidence so the authorities would never see it, to win a killer's trust.
citation: stage 40 journal: "I've done my part. The authorities won't see Viola's Butcher evidence. Time to return to <Alias=Collaborator> at the Atheron Residence." (asked at s30: "make sure Viola Giordano's evidence about the Butcher will never reach the authorities")
branch_note: Non-lethal variant of the same suppression; mutually exclusive with s35.

outcome: Killed the Dunmer friend, the Butcher of Windhelm, and took his black soul gem.
citation: stage 85 journal: "I decided to end the life of <Alias=MaleDunmer>. It pains me that I dragged him into this mess, but I need his soul to get into Umbriel."
branch_note: Kill branch; mutually exclusive with the spare at s90.

outcome: Spared the Dunmer friend, the Butcher of Windhelm.
citation: stage 90 journal: "I've decided to spare <Alias=MaleDunmer>. I'll find a different Black Soul Gem to get into Umbriel."
branch_note: Spare branch; mutually exclusive with the kill at s85.

outcome: Let the restrained Murob go free.
citation: stage 110 journal: "I've agreed to let Murob go. Now it's time to decide what to do about <Alias=FemaleOrc>."
branch_note: Release of the captive mother; separate decision from the daughter's fate.

outcome: Sacrificed the Orc friend and collected her soul gem.
citation: stage 125 journal: "In the end, I had to sacrifice <alias=FemaleOrc>. We need her soul gem."
branch_note: Sacrifice branch; mutually exclusive with the refusal at s130.

outcome: Refused to sacrifice the Orc friend.
citation: stage 130 journal: "I can't sacrifice <alias=FemaleOrc>. Not after everything that happened."
branch_note: Spare branch; s131 carries identical text and is the same outcome.

outcome: Sacrificed the Orc friend, the Chosen of Kynareth, and took her soul gem.
citation: stage 135 journal: "<Alias=FemaleOrc> is dead. I got her soul gem. She was truly the Chosen of Kynareth. Her sacrifice won't be in vain."
branch_note: Terminal of the sacrifice branch; mutually exclusive with s140.

outcome: Spared the Orc friend, the Chosen of Kynareth, and let her live.
citation: stage 140 journal: "<Alias=FemaleOrc> might not forgive me for what I've done. But at least she lives. She was truly the Chosen of Kynareth."
branch_note: Terminal of the spare branch; mutually exclusive with s135.

outcome: Became Umbra's Herald in Tamriel, freeing minds one at a time in defiance of the gods.
citation: stage 100 journal: "I've become Umbra's Herald in Tamriel. I will let people choose her freedom, one at a time, in defiance of the gods."
branch_note: Umbra-service branch chosen at s90; mutually exclusive with destroying her at s120/s130.

outcome: Let Umbra liberate every mind in Tamriel, unmaking the world of the gods and Princes.
citation: stage 110 journal: "In the end, Umbra convinced me to liberate everyone's mind, in Tamriel. This will bring about a brand new world, away from the gods and Daedric Princes."
branch_note: Fuller form of the same Umbra-service branch as s100; rowed separately so either landing scores.

outcome: Fought and destroyed Umbra in open battle.
citation: stage 130 journal: "Umbra is dead. Or as dead as she can be, for now. I must talk to Naenra." (act at s120 obj: "Defeat Umbra!")
branch_note: Destruction branch; mutually exclusive with s100/s110.

outcome: Chose to reunite Umbra with Daumbra rather than destroy her, at cost to himself.
citation: stage 150 journal: "I've decided to reunite Umbra with Daumbra. It's the right thing to do, even if it's costly."
branch_note: Reunion branch; terminal form at s230.

outcome: Defeated Umbra in battle and left Naenra behind to collect her power.
citation: stage 200 journal: "It's over. We defeated Umbra, and Naenra stayed behind to collect her power. She plans to take on the Daedric Princes next, starting with Clavicus."
branch_note: Terminal of the destruction branch; mutually exclusive with s210 and s230.

outcome: Cut Naenra out and refused to let her remain with them after the assault.
citation: stage 210 journal: "I couldn't allow Naenra to stay with us, after what happened. But what is done is done. Eternity beckons, and the world shall be very different."
branch_note: Terminal variant where Naenra is cast out; the text does not say how, so the betrayal read is inferred from s90 obj "Choose who must change".

outcome: Merged Umbra and Daumbra into one being and stayed with her.
citation: stage 230 journal: "Daumbra and Umbra are now the same being. Memories and love combined. We'll stay together through whatever comes next, and until the end of time."
branch_note: Terminal of the s150 reunion branch; mutually exclusive with s200 and s210.
